infobox.usage: Allows access to The Labyrinth location a single time.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Labrys access keycard (Labrys) is a Keycard in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A keycard to one of Knossos facilities. The design references the Minotaur mythos, but it's somewhat strange there are no Minotaur theme parks in Tarkov.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Will be consumed upon entering The Labyrinth. Will not be consumed in the practice and practice co-op game modes.
  - When playing in a group, all players need their own.
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
- Only 2 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

sections.heading: Quest rewards
sections.text:
- 2 can be obtained as initial equipment during the story chapter The Labyrinth
- 1 can be obtained as an initial equipment for Hypotheses Testing

sections.heading: The Labyrinth
sections.text:
- On Shadow of Tagilla
- On Vengeful Killa

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: In the basement of the health resort west wing on Shoreline. Knossos LLC facility key required.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: The QR code on the backside of the card reads "59.857850, 30.046943". These numbers are coordinates that point to the abandoned sanatorium "Strelna" near St. Petersburg, which the health resort on Shoreline is based on.
